pass_b_english: “And he himself will judge the inhabited world in righteousness; he will judge peoples in uprightness” (Psalm 9:9).

You will understand the inhabited world as the church, inhabited by both Father and Son, according to: “I and my Father will come, and we will make a dwelling with him” (John 14:23). And peoples as the rest besides the church, or those from circumcision. For as many as sinned in the law will be judged through the law, while the lawless who sinned perish lawlessly (Romans 2:12). Therefore those who have blameworthy deeds and an ungodly mind must fear such a judge.

choices.english: you will understand the inhabited world as the church
choices.why: Glossed as inhabited by Father and Son (John 14:23), not the Roman empire as such.
